title: bbregister
description: Performs within-subject, cross-modal registration using a boundary-based cost function.

subject.description: FreeSurfer subject name as found in $SUBJECTS_DIR.
subject.title: Subject

moveable_volume.description: "Moveable" volume template for cross-modal volume. E.g., fMRI volume used for motion correction.
moveable_volume.title: Moveable Volume

reg_file.description: Output FreeSurfer registration file (tkregister-style or LTA format).
reg_file.title: Registration File

contrast_type_t1.description: Assume T1 contrast, White Matter brighter than Grey Matter.
contrast_type_t1.title: T1 Contrast

contrast_type_t2.description: Assume T2 contrast, Grey Matter brighter than White Matter. Same as --bold and --dti.
contrast_type_t2.title: T2/BOLD/DTI Contrast

vsm.description: Include B0 distortion correction. A voxel shift map can be created with the epidewarp.fsl script.
vsm.title: Voxel Shift Map

no_coreg_ref_mask.description: Do not use aparc+aseg.mgz as a reference mask.
no_coreg_ref_mask.title: No Coreg Ref Mask

init_header.description: Use geometry info for close voxel-to-voxel registration. Typically valid if acquired in same session.
init_header.title: Initialize Header

init_reg.description: Supply an initial registration matrix; can be LTA format.
init_reg.title: Initial Reg File

intvol.description: Volume used as an intermediate during registration. Useful for partial field-of-view volumes.
intvol.title: Intermediate Volume

mid_frame.description: Register to middle frame (not with --frame option).
mid_frame.title: Middle Frame Registration

o_outvol.description: Resample moveable volume and save as specified output volume.
o_outvol.title: Output Volume

s_from_reg.description: Get subject name from registration file.
s_from_reg.title: Subject from Reg
